verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਏਕ ਸੇ ਅਧਿਕ ਏਕ  ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਭਾਗ ਸਊਤੈ ਸਮ ਧਾਮ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa kai naikaa anek ek se adhik ek  pooran suhaag bhaag suootai sam dhaam hai ||

en.bdb: A beloved husband who has many wives and each one better than the other, each one enjoys all the love, attention of husband and other comforts of life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਨ ਹੁਇ ਮਾਨ ਭੰਗ ਬਿਛੁਰ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਰਹੀ  ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਯੋਗ ਲਗ ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਭਾਮ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: maanan hui maan bha(n)g bichhur bidhes rahee  bireh biyog lag birahanee bhaam hai ||

en.bdb: Separated from her dear husband and living far away from him, she feels her respect getting compromised, beside bearing the pangs of separation and thus is called separated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਥਲ ਸਮਾਨ ਤ੍ਰੀਯਾ ਸਕੇ ਨ ਰਿਝਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਦਇਓ ਹੈ ਦੁਹਾਗ ਵੈ ਦੁਹਾਗਨ ਸਨਾਮ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sithal samaan treeyaa sake na rijhai piray dhio hai dhuhaag vai dhuhaagan sanaam hai ||

en.bdb: Like lazy people, idle wife cannot please her husband and as a result she is known as one who has been abandoned by her husband.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਚਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਜੀਹ ਕਰ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਹੀਨ  ਪਰਸਿਓ ਨ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਹਾ ਨਾਮ ਹੈ ॥੬੪੨॥
verses.translit_en: lochan sravan jeeh kar a(n)g a(n)g heen  parasio na pekhio sunio mero kahaa naam hai ||642||

en.bdb: I have not felt my beloved with any part of my body. I have not seen Him with my eyes, not heard His praises with my ears, not uttered His name with my tongue nor have I done any service with my hands. Bereft of all these, with what name can I be called?
